## Demo 1 — Inbound Lead Triage
**Flow:** Lead form → validate → dedupe against the Leads sheet → AI score (HOT / WARM / COLD) → append to sheet → instant Gmail alert for HOT & WARM.

**Before first run (see repo README):**
1. Connect your Google account in both Google Sheets nodes and the Gmail node, and point the Sheets nodes at your demo sheet.
2. Replace `YOUR_GEMINI_API_KEY` in the AI node (free key from Google AI Studio).
3. Replace `YOUR_EMAIL@example.com` in the Gmail alert node.
4. In Settings, set the Error Workflow to the companion error-handler workflow.
